name: Manaen
bio: Manaen, who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, was one of the prophets and teachers at the church in Antioch, along with Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, and Saul, among whom the Holy Spirit called out Barnabas and Saul for the missionary work ahead (Acts 13:1-3).
